sources.quote: R Lyrae, also known by its Flamsteed designation 13 Lyrae and named Niandao, is a 4th magnitude semiregular variable star in the constellation Lyra, approximately 350 light-years away from Earth.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 2,398 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,363 K, so 144.458 solar radii.
